82: And some of them close but do not open -- like a blessing which is close to its fellow which already opened. In the first blessing and the final blessing of the reading of Sh'ma, "True and stalwart" and "Truth and belief" that even though the reading of the Sh'ma breaks them up the blessings which were before rely on them, are for them "close to their  fellow."
Who is the good and makes good etc. -- which is not close to its fellow, which is not the blessing on victuals but on the grave of those killed at Beitar they mandated it.
